title: sida texana
intro: Sida texana, commonly known as Texas mallow or prairie mallow, is a perennial plant native to the southern United States and Mexico. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sida texana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe irritated tissues and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Sida texana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
